See also: Gatto and gàtto

Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
gatto
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

    Inherited from Late Latin cattum.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈɡat.to/
    • Audio (un gatto):(file)
    • Audio:(file)
    • Rhymes: -atto
    • Hyphenation: gàt‧to

    Noun

    [edit]

    gatto m (plural gatti, feminine gatta, diminutive gattìno, augmentative gattóne, pejorative gattàccio or gattonàccio, derogatory gattùccio)

    1. cat
    2. (male) tom, tomcat
